title: Mexican Wedding Invitation 6 Templates
author: Akasha Events
description:
REF. 0033-1019
A. DESCRIPTION
Mexican Theme Wedding Invitation 6 Templates, Mexican Wedding Invitation 6 Templates, Wedding Invitation Mexican Style, Fully Editable Wedding Invitation 6 Templates, 6 Plantillas de Invitación de Boda, Invitación de Boda, ENG+SPA, instant download.
NO SOFTWARE OR EXPERIENCE NEEDED. Canva is completely FREE and easy to use! You can download and modify the template infinite number of times! If you like to edit it on your phone or tablet, you’ll need to download CANVA App. It’s free!
══════════════════
B. ALL ITEMS INCLUDED
1. Wedding Invitation Template, dim. 5” x 7”, text 1, English
2. Wedding Invitation Template, dim. 5” x 7”, text 2, English
3. Wedding Invitation Template, dim. 5” x 7”, text 3, English
4. Wedding Invitation Template, dim. 5” x 7”, text 4, English
5. Wedding Invitation Template, dim. 5” x 7”, text 5, Spanish
6. Wedding Invitation Template, dim. 5” x 7”, text 6, Spanish
══════════════════
C. HOW IT WORKS
1. Add to Cart & Purchase.
2. After purchasing, you will receive a PDF File with link to open and edit your template(s) in Canva.
3. Click the link to go to the Canva website.
4. Open and start editing your template(s). You can save your template(s) and continue editing at any time.
5. Once you have finished editing your template(s), save and download the template(s).
6. Print your template(s) from home, from a local print shop or an online print store.
NO SOFTWARE OR EXPERIENCE NEEDED. Canva is completely FREE and easy to use! If you like to edit it on your phone or tablet, you’ll need to download CANVA App. It’s free!
